system.name: QRWTY
system.description: Public short links and QR codes. Guests create links without signing in; accounts own, edit and analyse theirs; individual free and paid plans. A redirect is sent only after its click is durably acknowledged.

tile.name: Session API
tile.description: Same-origin browser facade: OIDC code + PKCE sign-in, cookie sessions and CSRF. Forwards a valid bearer token (none on guest create) to the Link, Account and Billing APIs; never invents an identity header.

tile.name: Identity
tile.description: Verified account identity over OIDC. Local Keycloak while testing; the managed issuer is a deployment compatibility decision.

tile.name: Sessions
tile.description: Encrypted tokens, session expiry and revocation state. A separate restricted PostgreSQL logical database, written only by Session API and never queried by the Redirect service.

tile.name: Link API
tile.description: Guest create, claim with one-time proof, owned edits and deletes, abuse reports and operator decisions. Sole writer of Links; asks Billing API for entitlement grants on owned operations.

tile.name: Account API
tile.description: Signed-in reads: the caller's own links and their analytics. Reads the Links owner view and Analytics, checks entitlements with Billing API, and forwards no writes.

tile.name: Billing API
tile.description: Hosted Checkout and portal, a signature-verified Stripe webhook inbox, subscription reconciliation and entitlement grants. Sole writer of Billing.

tile.name: Links
tile.description: Durable routes, ownership, claim and idempotency data and tombstones. PostgreSQL; the public route view and the account owner view have separate grants.

tile.name: Admission cache
tile.description: Approximate distributed abuse and admission counters (Valkey). Durable hard account limits stay in Links transactions.

tile.name: Reputation API
tile.description: Destination reputation check before a link is created. Unavailable means a retryable 503 on create; existing redirects continue.

tile.name: Redirect service
tile.description: Resolves host and slug, checks state and expiry, awaits the durable click acknowledgment, then answers 302. No sign-in or payment dependency.

tile.name: Hot routes
tile.description: Short-lived route metadata with a bounded freshness deadline (Valkey). Replaceable, never the source of truth.

tile.name: Click events
tile.description: Click events, durably acknowledged before each redirect. Production transport is GCP Pub/Sub, pending G12; the local export uses the installed broker. The archive subscription is deployment.

tile.name: Analytics worker
tile.description: Validates, deduplicates and aggregates click events, expires bounded data and acknowledges only after its transaction commits. Sole writer of Analytics.

tile.name: Analytics
tile.description: Click aggregates plus bounded deduplication data. A separate PostgreSQL logical database, read by Account API.

tile.name: Billing
tile.description: Customer mappings, webhook inbox, subscription and entitlement revisions, reconciliation jobs and action idempotency. Restricted PostgreSQL logical database; no card data.

tile.name: Stripe API
tile.description: Hosted payments and subscriptions (test mode). Its signed webhook reaches Billing API through the Create, manage & pay entry, not a line out of this tile.
